say: Welcome to Stall. In this video, let's create your account. It only takes a minute.
When you open Stall, you'll see a few quick slides about how it works. Tap Next to read them, or tap Skip to go straight in.
First, choose who you are. Pick I'm a student if you study there, or I run a shop if you own a business on campus.
Start typing your school's name, then tap it in the list. Stall shows you people and shops from your school first.
Next, add your full name, your matric number, your email, and your WhatsApp number. Buyers and sellers use it to reach you about orders.
Create a password with at least eight characters. Then add your hostel, or where you stay, so meeting up is easy.
Read and tick the box to agree to the terms. Then tap Create account.
And that's it. You're in. Welcome to Stall! In the next video, I'll show you around the app.
